data.name: Raylan
data.gender_notes: Raylan is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'Rhaios' meaning 'King' and 'Anax' meaning 'Lord' or 'Ruler'. This name is mentioned in the New Testament as the name of a centurion who had faith and was healed by Jesus. The name Raylan carries the meaning “King's ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Raylan usually hope their child will grow to embody king's ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Raylan belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “King's ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raylan total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: ריילן
in_hebrew.meaning: הילד שלי הוא אלוהים, אלוהים הוא אור
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם ריילן הוא שילוב של שני שמות עבריים, 'רי' שפירושו 'אלוהים' או 'אור', ו'ילן' שפירושו 'עץ' או 'בן'. השם ריילן יכול להתפרש כ'אלוהים הוא עץ החיים' או 'אלוהים הוא בן האור'. השם נמצא בשימוש בקרב הנוצרים כמחווה לאלוהים כמקור האור והחיים.

in_greek.name: Ράιλαν
in_greek.meaning: Το παιδί μου είναι Θεός, Θεός είναι φως
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ράιλαν είναι σύνθεση δύο εβραϊκών ονομάτων, 'Ρει' που σημαίνει 'Θεός' ή 'φως', και 'Ιλάν' που σημαίνει 'δέντρο' ή 'γιός'. Το όνομα Ράιλαν μπορεί να ερμηνευτεί ως 'Θεός είναι το δέντρο της ζωής' ή 'Θεός είναι ο γιος του φωτός'. Το όνομα χρησιμοποιείται από τους Χριστιανούς ως φόρο τιμής στον Θεό ως πηγή φωτός και ζωής.

in_latin.name: Raylan
in_latin.meaning: Filius meus est Deus, Deus est lux
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Raylan est compositum ex duobus nominibus hebraicis, 'Rey' quod significat 'Deus' vel 'lux', et 'Ilán' quod significat 'arbor' vel 'filius'. Nomen Raylan interpretari potest ut 'Deus est arbor vitae' vel 'Deus est filius lucis'. Hoc nomen a Christianis usurpatur ut testimonium Deo tamquam fonti lucis et vitae.

in_english.name: Raylan
in_english.meaning: God is my light, God is my protector
in_english.long_meaning: The name Raylan is derived from Hebrew roots, combining 'ray' meaning 'God' or 'light' and 'lan' meaning 'tree' or 'son'. It can be interpreted as 'God is the tree of life' or 'God is the son of light'. In Christian tradition, the name Raylan symbolizes God's presence as a source of light and protection. Historically, the name has been used to signify faith and divine guidance.
